_doc: Strict zones for `make claims` (gegenprobe.claims.zone_check): every numeric token in a zone must be bound to a claim whose `where` lists the document, by an anchor in claims_anchor.json that holds the claim's value at that position. Round 13: README.md, technical_report.md and docs/form_notes.md are strict end to end. A zone is {start, end} (literals; null = top/end) or a list of them. `allow` lists the non-claims literally, each with why. Round 14: `small_int_tables` lists result tables (by the start of their header row) whose integer cells below 10 must be bound too; scope words (post hoc, registered, exploratory, in-sample, held out, weighted, unweighted) must sit inside an anchor phrase or an allowlisted phrase; `pinned` phrases must occur exactly `count` times.
